BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing residences for sex offenders; andadding a new section to chapter 9.94A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.94A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state may establish residence restrictions and communityprotection zones for registered sex offenders. Local laws andordinances that are inconsistent with, more restrictive than, or exceedthe requirements of state law shall not be enacted and are preempted.
